title: Teaching the Child Sabr in Illness and Pain

text_simplified: Parents must teach their children sabr (patience) and endurance when facing illness or pain, and not to rush into complaining. They should also instill the concept of reward and recompense from Allah for sabr in trials. This helps the child strengthen their character and bear responsibility.
